groups.name: app.ai
groups.description: General AI services and model configuration.

properties.name: app.upload-dir
properties.description: Directory where uploaded files are stored.

properties.name: app.security.mock
properties.description: Whether to bypass OAuth2 security checks using mock credentials.

properties.name: app.security.api-key
properties.description: Static API key used for securing raw ingest or API endpoints.

properties.name: app.security.secret-key
properties.description: Encryption key for storing credentials/tokens at-rest. If blank, secrets remain in plaintext.

properties.name: app.security.secret-salt
properties.description: Key derivation function salt (hex) used for at-rest secret encryption.

properties.name: app.security.roles.admin-claim
properties.description: OAuth2 token claim value identifying users with administrator rights.

properties.name: app.security.roles.user-claim
properties.description: OAuth2 token claim value identifying basic users.

properties.name: app.security.mcp.allowed-audience
properties.description: Allowed audience identifier for JWT validation in MCP requests.

properties.name: app.security.mcp.required-scope
properties.description: Required scope in JWT for accessing the MCP service.

properties.name: app.security.mcp.resource-url
properties.description: The target resource URL for MCP access authorization validation.

properties.name: app.security.mcp.authorization-server-url
properties.description: OAuth2 authorization server token/issuer configuration URL.

properties.name: app.ai.provider
properties.description: Active LLM client provider backend ('cloudflare-gemini', 'gemini', 'openrouter' or 'azure-openai').

properties.name: app.ai.openrouter.base-url
properties.description: API URL endpoint for OpenRouter service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.openrouter.api-key
properties.description: Authentication token/API Key for OpenRouter service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.gemini.api-key
properties.description: Authentication token/API Key for Google Gemini service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.gemini.enable-thinking
properties.description: Whether to request Google Gemini thinking level models.

properties.name: app.ai.gemini.thinking-level
properties.description: Thinking level for reasoning effort of Gemini models (low, medium, high).

properties.name: app.ai.azure-openai.endpoint
properties.description: Azure OpenAI resource endpoint, e.g. https://my-resource.openai.azure.com. Required when the provider is azure-openai: without it the SDK would target the public OpenAI service.

properties.name: app.ai.azure-openai.api-key
properties.description: Authentication token/API Key for Azure OpenAI service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.azure-openai.enable-thinking
properties.description: Whether to send a reasoning effort to Azure OpenAI reasoning models.

properties.name: app.ai.azure-openai.thinking-level
properties.description: Reasoning effort for Azure OpenAI reasoning models (minimal, low, medium, high).

properties.name: app.ai.azure-openai.reasoning-models
properties.description: Comma-separated Azure deployment names that address a reasoning model. Empty means detect from the deployment name.

properties.name: app.ai.orchestrator.max-review-rounds
properties.description: Review rounds an orchestrated answer may take before it is delivered flagged. The effective value for a run comes from the orchestrator_profiles row; this applies when a profile does not set one, and is what the admin form is pre-filled with. It is defined here rather than as a literal in the controller or the template because those copies drifted: the limit was raised to 3 in one place and stayed 2 in five others.

properties.name: app.ai.orchestrator.max-specialist-calls
properties.description: Specialist delegations one orchestrated run may make. Same resolution order as app.ai.orchestrator.max-review-rounds: the profile row wins, this is the fallback and the admin form's pre-filled value.

properties.name: app.ai.rag.max-iterations
properties.description: Maximum agentic tool invocation loop iterations during retrieval.

properties.name: app.ai.rag.max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum output tokens limit for primary agentic generation.

properties.name: app.ai.rag.temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature for RAG prompt completion.

properties.name: app.ai.rag.default-prompt-name
properties.description: Database key of default playbook or instructions to retrieve.

properties.name: app.ai.rag.thinking-level
properties.description: Thinking level for reasoning effort of Gemini models in RAG (low, medium, high).

properties.name: app.ai.kg.model
properties.description: The specific LLM identifier used for parsing entities and links.

properties.name: app.ai.kg.max-tokens
properties.description: Output token capacity for knowledge graph JSON generation.

properties.name: app.ai.kg.temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature for knowledge graph extractor LLM.

properties.name: app.ai.kg.concurrency
properties.description: Number of concurrent document parsing threads active during graph creation.

properties.name: app.ai.kg.max-attempts
properties.description: Attempts before skipped when extractor returns invalid format outputs.

properties.name: app.ai.kg.thinking-level
properties.description: Thinking level for reasoning effort of Gemini models in KG extraction (low, medium, high).

properties.name: app.ai.summarize.model
properties.description: LLM model identifying code for document summary task.

properties.name: app.ai.summarize.max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum output tokens limit for document summarization.

properties.name: app.ai.summarize.temperature
properties.description: Temperature setting for document summarizer.

properties.name: app.ai.summarize.concurrency
properties.description: Maximum concurrent virtual thread tasks for summaries.

properties.name: app.ai.summarize.thinking-level
properties.description: Thinking level for reasoning effort of Gemini models in summarization (low, medium, high).

properties.name: app.ai.embedding.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of standard semantic text embeddings service.

properties.name: app.ai.embedding.api-key
properties.description: Authentication token/API Key for semantic embedding service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.embedding.model
properties.description: Specific embedding model name.

properties.name: app.ai.ranking.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of candidate document reranking service.

properties.name: app.ai.ranking.api-key
properties.description: Authentication token/API Key for reranking service requests.

properties.name: app.ai.ranking.model
properties.description: Specific reranking model name.

properties.name: app.retrieval.default-limit
properties.description: Default maximum number of document chunks to fetch as context.

properties.name: app.retrieval.log-query-max-chars
properties.description: Character limit printed to console logs during semantic requests.

properties.name: app.retrieval.semantic-limit-multiplier
properties.description: Candidate count multiplier for semantic retrieval before final rerank step.

properties.name: app.retrieval.rrf.k
properties.description: RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) constant value.

properties.name: app.retrieval.rrf.semantic-weight
properties.description: Scale factor for semantic rank metrics.

properties.name: app.retrieval.rrf.fulltext-weight
properties.description: Scale factor for BM25/full-text rank metrics.

properties.name: app.retrieval.max-limit
properties.description: Hard ceiling on the number of chunks any retrieval may return. HybridSearch clamps every request to it, and it is woven into the search_corpus tool schema the model reads, so the advertised ceiling and the enforced one cannot drift apart.

properties.name: app.retrieval.fulltext-limit-multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied to the requested limit when sizing the full-text candidate pool before fusion.

properties.name: app.worker.enabled
properties.description: Configures whether background ingestion processes are active on this node.

properties.name: app.worker.concurrency
properties.description: Maximum concurrent ingestion worker threads.

properties.name: app.worker.poll-interval
properties.description: Duration interval for checking ingestion tasks.

properties.name: app.chat.enabled
properties.description: Global status controlling web chat UI availability.

properties.name: app.chat.allowed-models
properties.description: Acceptable AI models allowed to be selected by the UI.

properties.name: rest-client.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds for outbound REST client requests.

properties.name: rest-client.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Socket read timeout in milliseconds for outbound REST client requests.
